connectorUiConfig.title: Cloudflare (Using Blob Container) (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Cloudflare data connector ingests Cloudflare Logpush data from Azure Blob Storage into Microsoft Sentinel. Add separate collectors for Cloudflare accounts and storage containers in one workspace, with account attribution on each ingested record. The collector uses the Microsoft first-party application, and Event Grid delivers notifications using a managed identity. Refer to the [Cloudflare Logs documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/about/) for more information.

sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| summarize Events = count(), LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated) by CloudflareAccountId, CloudflareAccountName

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: Deployment permissions
customs.description: The deploying identity needs resource deployment permissions in the workspace and storage resource groups, and permission to create the required role assignments at the storage scopes. Contributor plus Role Based Access Control Administrator, or Owner, at the applicable scopes can provide these permissions. Register Microsoft.EventGrid in the storage subscription.

customs.name: Microsoft Sentinel collector permissions
customs.description: The deployment grants the Microsoft first-party enterprise application selected below Storage Blob Data Reader on the selected container and Storage Queue Data Contributor on the two per-instance queues. It does not grant account-key access or storage-management permissions to the collector.

customs.name: Event Grid delivery identity
customs.description: The deployment enables a system-assigned managed identity on the storage account's Event Grid system topic. Choose Create to grant that identity Storage Queue Data Message Sender on the storage account. Use existing skips only that sender grant and requires the same topic identity to already have the role; it does not skip the collector grants.

customs.name: Cloudflare Logpush
customs.description: Configure Cloudflare Logpush to write gzip-compressed JSON logs to the selected container. Cloudflare's write access is separate from Microsoft Sentinel's read access. See [Logpush permissions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/permissions/) and [Azure destination setup](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/azure/).

customs.name: Role-assignment propagation
customs.description: Azure data-plane permissions can take time to propagate. If an initial connection or Event Grid delivery authorization fails, wait up to ten minutes and retry with the same account, storage, and workspace values. Deterministic naming reuses the same collector resources; elapsed time alone is not proof of authorization.

customs.name: Cleanup semantics
customs.description: Deleting a Microsoft Sentinel connector does not delete its DCR, DCE, diagnostic setting, queues, Event Grid subscription, or role assignments. Remove only resources belonging to the intended collector. Preserve any table or Event Grid system topic still used by another collector.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Prepare Azure Storage and Cloudflare Logpush
instructionSteps.description: Create a storage account and private blob container, then configure Cloudflare Logpush to write gzip-compressed JSON logs there. Follow [Create a storage account](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/storage/common/storage-account-create), [Create a container](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/storage/blobs/blob-containers-portal), and [Configure the Cloudflare Azure destination](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/enable-destinations/azure/).

instructionSteps.title: 2. Add and review Cloudflare collectors
instructionSteps.description: Add a collector for each Cloudflare account and storage container combination. Reusing the same identity values targets the same resources. Use separate containers for independently attributed accounts; overlapping collectors on the same blobs can ingest duplicate events.

parameters.title: Add a Cloudflare collector
parameters.subtitle: Cloudflare Logpush through Azure Blob Storage
parameters.label: Add new collector
Cloudflare account ID
parameters.description: The immutable account identifier used for collector naming and ingested account attribution. Do not enter an API token or other secret.
parameters.name: CloudflareAccountId

parameters.label: Cloudflare account display name
parameters.description: A friendly label retained on ingested records. Changing the label does not create another collector.
parameters.name: CloudflareAccountName

parameters.label: Storage account region
parameters.description: The Azure region of the storage account, for example westus2. This is not necessarily the resource group's region.
parameters.name: StorageAccountLocation

parameters.label: Blob folder prefix (optional)
parameters.description: Restrict notifications to this folder beneath the selected container. Omit leading and trailing slashes. Leave blank for the whole container.
parameters.name: blobFolderName

parameters.label: Existing Event Grid system topic (optional)
parameters.description: Azure supports one system topic per storage account. Enter its name if one already exists; it must reference the selected storage account. Otherwise leave blank to create the deterministic topic. Existing topic identities and tags are preserved.
parameters.name: EGSystemTopicName

parameters.title: Event Grid Storage Queue Data Message Sender assignment
parameters.name: eventGridRbacMode

options.label: Create the required storage-account role assignment
Use an existing assignment for this topic identity

parameters.label: Custom log table name (optional)
parameters.description: Leave blank for CloudflareV2_CL. Collectors with the same table name share that table. The default connector queries use CloudflareV2_CL; adjust queries when selecting another table.
parameters.name: TableName

validations.message: Use a table name starting with a letter, containing only letters, digits and underscores, and ending with _CL.
